Title: Good Morning Front-Facing Two-Shot at the Desert Oasis

Duration: 15 seconds

Format: 16:9 horizontal

Cinematic Style: Hand-painted watercolor and gouache storybook animation matching the current Magic English Voyage art direction, adapted for the desert map. Warm early-morning cream sunlight, soft sand and clay earth tones, pale mint-green oasis plants, tiny coral-pink accents, soft pencil outlines, visible paper grain, low-saturation colors, gentle imperfect brush texture, cozy quiet emotion. Characters should look warm, clean, attractive, and child-safe: bright clean eyes, soft cheeks, balanced proportions, gentle smiles, refined hand-painted character design. It must feel hand-drawn and alive, not glossy 3D or plastic CGI.

Source Situation: Two young children meet at the desert oasis in the morning, staged in a front-facing two-shot. They stand slightly angled toward each other but both bodies and faces are open toward the camera. The sun is low and warm behind the camera side, softly lighting both faces. They look at each other with friendly eyes, then glance gently toward the viewer while greeting each other politely with "Good morning." The meaning of the English expression "Good morning" must be visually clear through morning light, waking-up freshness, friendly waves, eye contact, visible smiles, and clearly visible front or front-three-quarter faces. No classroom, no flashcards, no written labels.
